conventions.assembly_rule: An assembly may only reference assemblies below it. Enforced by .asmdef references, so a violation is a compile error.
conventions.hard_prohibition: No #if UNITY_ANDROID anywhere under PET.Edit or PET.Save.
never_cut: The three shaping tools (terraforming, water, planting)
conventions.cut_order: Cuts come from the top of the written order in Deliverable 5 S08. Do not skip a row. Do not cut two things at once. A cut is recorded in the same commit that takes it.
conventions.commits: Conventional Commits; scope is the assembly without the prefix or an area (art, ci, docs, board).
conventions.branches: Trunk-based. main always compiles and passes the gate. wk/NN-slug, exp/slug, fix/slug. Never commit directly to main except docs and the board data file.
conventions.falling_behind_trigger: Two consecutive milestones missing their exit criterion. Re-read Deliverable 5 S08 before taking any cut.

one_line: The plan is fully ticketed and the repository is consistent; the gate has never run because there is no Unity licence secret, and the C# has never been compiled. Add UNITY_LICENSE, run Tools/run_bench.sh --tier linux --attempt 0, and write the report before starting week 2.
